reference_policy_design: Both adapters are initialized FROM THE SAME SFT checkpoint (sft_adapter_path), loaded onto one shared 4-bit base model. The 'reference' adapter is then frozen (requires_grad=False, eval mode) so it represents the instruction-tuned state immediately before DPO starts -- not the untouched raw base model. Only the 'policy' adapter is trainable. DPOTrainer/DPOConfig are given ref_model=None with model_adapter_name='policy' and ref_adapter_name='reference', so TRL toggles adapters on one shared base rather than materializing a second full model copy. train_dpo.py verifies this setup explicitly (prints which named parameters are trainable vs frozen) before training starts, since this behavior must be confirmed against the installed TRL/PEFT versions rather than assumed.
